test.create_query: CREATE TABLE limit_by_pushdown_main (k String, sel UInt8, v UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (sel, k)
CREATE TABLE limit_by_pushdown_set (k String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO limit_by_pushdown_main SELECT concat('e', toString(number % 2500000)) AS k, toUInt8(cityHash64(number) % 4) AS sel, number AS v FROM numbers_mt(5000000)
INSERT INTO limit_by_pushdown_set SELECT concat('e', toString(number)) AS k FROM numbers_mt(2000000)
test.query: SELECT count() FROM ( SELECT k, v FROM limit_by_pushdown_main WHERE sel = 0 AND v % 512 = 0 LIMIT 1 BY k ) WHERE k IN (SELECT k FROM limit_by_pushdown_set) SETTINGS query_plan_filter_push_down = 0
